newsitem.title: UK: Aluminium ends LME easier, cash/Sept back flares.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium ends LME easier, cash/Sept back flares.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Ends with trimmed losses, but feature is widening backwardation, due to cash/Sept borrowing.
COPPER - Closes easier, manages to stem falls near $2,150.
NICKEL - Ends with pared gains. OTHERS - Close quiet.
ZINC - Closes easier, under $1,500 after mid-afternoon mark-down. Backwardation narrows slightly.
